Question 3
?

Let F(x,y,z)=ey+zi+ex+zj+ex+yk and let C be a path in R3. Which of the following is equivalent to ∫CF⋅dr?

a
∫Cey+zdx+ex+zdy+ex+ydz
b
∫C2ex+y+zdxdydz
c
∫Ce2(x+y+z)dxdydz
d
∫Cex+zdx+ex+ydy+ey+zdz
e
∫Cey+zdydz+ex+zdxdz+ex+ydxdy
Submit
